description: The runtime subset of the Wielder Train package: pinned requirements (requirements-wielder.txt), the wielder_train package (preflight.py + cli.py), and the four training configs (Dorowani + Wispkin Illustrious XL). Attach this dataset to the mochiichao-wielder-train kernel alongside marsfmmg/mochiichao-likeness-datasets; the kernel searches /kaggle/input for this package, copytrees it into /kaggle/working/wielder-training, and prints PKG_STAGED before doing anything else. Wrapper contents are Wielder's own (Apache-2.0); the trainer it installs (kohya sd-scripts v0.12.3) is fetched separately at its verified pin and carries its own Apache-2.0 licence — see PROVENANCE.md in the repo copy at show/production/wielder/training/.
subtitle: Runtime subset of the Wielder Train lane (requirements, wielder_train preflight/CLI, configs) — staged automatically by the mochiichao-wielder-train kernel.
title: Mochiichao Wielder Training Package
